name: @design-system/tokens
description: Comprehensive design token package — colors, typography, spacing, elevation, motion, borders

scripts.validate: node -e "const flat = require('./dist/tokens.flat.json'); const unresolved = Object.entries(flat).filter(([k, v]) => typeof v === 'string' && /\{[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\}/.test(v)); if(unresolved.length) { console.error('Unresolved aliases:', unresolved); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('All aliases resolved. Token count:', Object.keys(flat).length); }"
